tagline: 禄来胶片单反相机，1994 年发布
description: 禄来于1994年推出的胶片单反相机。配备Bayonet mount Rollei (license built Carl Zeiss) Planar 2.8/80mm with HFT coating.。使用With standard Back 6x6 on 120 film type. With optional exchangeable film magazine also 6x6 or 4.5x6 on 120 or 220 film types.。
